shortDescription: Management of resource tags in ManageIQ

options.name: resource_id
options.description: The ID of the resource at which tags are controlled. Must be specified if O(resource_name) is not set. Both options are mutually exclusive.

options.name: resource_name
options.description: The name of the resource at which tags are be controlled. Must be specified if O(resource_id) is not set. Both options are mutually exclusive.

options.name: resource_type
options.description: The relevant resource type in manageiq.

options.name: state
options.description: V(absent) - tags should not exist, V(present) - tags should exist.

options.name: tags
options.description: V(tags) - list of dictionaries, each includes C(name) and C(category) keys. Required if O(state) is V(present) or V(absent).
